messages:
Alex: infra-bot just paged me for controlplane-lag in eu-north1 — GPU evictions rising. Can we shift non-critical burst traffic to eu-west1 pilot pool? Paging noise incoming.

infra-bot: ALERT: controlplane-lag eu-north1 — eviction_rate=0.42, pending_pods=128, alert_id=9872. paging: oncall-sre.

Emma: On it. Connected to the cluster. Scheduler loops are high, kube-scheduler cpu ~90%, io_wait elevated.

Raj: Recommend temporary routing policy: route 'burst' class -> eu-west1:pilot. Liz, can you run a gradual traffic shift? +10% every 2m, rollback on error or latency >1.5x baseline.

Liz: Will do. Command I'm going to run:
```
rictl traffic shift \n  --from eu-north1 \n  --to eu-west1:pilot \n  --classes burst \n  --step 10% \n  --interval 120s \n  --health-check "p50_latency<200ms && errors<0.5%"
```

Liz: Starting shift at 1842554380 (now). Monitoring: https://console.redwood/ops/dashboards/eu-north1

Noah: I'll watch GPU queues and eviction trends. If evictions don't fall in ~6m we trigger on-demand scale in eu-north1 (reserved pool), but note cost impact.

Log snippet from scheduler node:
```
[2026-05-03T14:06:12Z] eviction_score=0.76 gpu_free=8/64 pending_jobs=124
[2026-05-03T14:07:40Z] scheduler_loop=95% cpu=81% io_wait=22%
```

Emma: Shift started. First step 10% applied. No immediate errors. eu-west1 p50 latency +15% but still <200ms.

Liz: Noted. Proceeding with next steps.

Raj: @Emma keep an eye on controlplane 5xx rate. If sustained >0.2% abort and rollback.

Emma: Good call. Also pushing a small client-side tweak to reduce controlplane chattiness — bumping routing cache TTL for prefix lookups to 60s.

infra-bot: NOTE: alert_id 9872 pager-suppression enabled for 30m due to planned mitigation.

Noah: After three steps (30% diverted) evictions dropped to 0.14, pending_jobs=32. Signals look positive.

Alex: Plan: continue ramp to up to 70% for non-critical burst traffic, keep critical traffic pinned to eu-north1. If controlplane stays high we'll schedule an on-demand capacity add. Also please add a short note in the oncall handoff doc.

Liz: Done — added "eu-north1 controlplane lag mitigation" to /handbooks/oncall/shift-notes with actions and timestamps.

Raj: We'll produce a short postmortem and cost estimate. Preliminary: pilot pool traffic shift adds ~+$0.9/hr during peak window.

Emma: :thumbsup: I'll own this through handoff and validate autoscaler thresholds. Rolling changes to autoscaler min/max underway.

Alex: Thanks all. I'll update #incidents with a summary and hand off to Emma at 1842554600 (in ~10m).
